nodes.title: Upper edge allowed for strongly coupled modes below the rotor bands

nodes.title: Lower edge allowed for strongly coupled modes above the rotor bands
nodes.how: Cruise 2P 243-253 Hz, 20 % separation rule (A-P10(a)).

nodes.title: Highest strongly coupled mode below the rotor bands (hi corner)
nodes.how: Tap test of the built cage (T-A-TAP): modes within +-20 % of FE or re-tune. Margin is about 7 % at the hi corner, 31 % at kd.

nodes.title: Lowest strongly coupled mode above the rotor bands (kd corner, fin f1)
nodes.how: Fin tap test at build (T-A-TAP): f1 432-525 Hz in FE.

nodes.title: highest
nodes.equation: worst FC acceleration over 6,000-10,500 rpm, U 1.0 g mm per rotor, zeta 1 % and 0.5 %, kd / nom / hi; read from structures/iter3_run.md, not re-run

nodes.title: Flight-controller vibration, worst of the forced-response sweep
nodes.how: IMU VIBE < 30 m/s2 in the first tethered hover (T-A-TETHER-VIBE). The worst point (10,500 rpm) is unreachable; at the 0.90 cap (9,349 rpm) the sweep reads 19.6-20.1.

nodes.title: lowest
nodes.equation: smallest gain margin over pitch / roll / yaw x kd / nom / hi at the nominal mode frequencies (fu_cage.py); read from iter3_run.md, not re-run

nodes.title: Rate-loop gain margin, minimum over axes and corners (nominal modes)
nodes.how: Re-run sitl/fu_cage.py with the built-cage tap-test frequencies; hard-mounted FC.

nodes.title: gm shifted
nodes.equation: smallest gain margin with all flexible modes shifted -20 % and +20 % (tap-test tolerance)

nodes.title: Rate-loop gain margin with the cage modes shifted +-20 %
nodes.how: Tap test of the built cage (T-A-TAP): first pitch mode 9-17 Hz, first roll mode 21-43 Hz (GM >= 2 grid, iter3_run.md); outside that window re-tune the rate loop.
nodes.note: D-191 (CLAIMS-FIX s4): with the QP-3 gains (pitch P 0.15 / D 0.002 / FLTD 40) the minimum was 1.64 (1.56 at cant 17); pitch P 0.12 / D 0.0012 / FLTD 60 and yaw P 0.37 give 2.03 (roll, kd corner, modes -20 %; pitch 2.33).

nodes.title: servo factors
nodes.equation: factor = servo torque / (1.5 x (hinge moment at VD + preload + damper at slew)); cold case with the real arm ratio 12.9 / 12; ratio = servo / hinge

nodes.title: Servo torque factor at 7.2 V, 25 C (ES3054HV)
nodes.how: M12: measure the rail under two-servo load (7.2 V jumper set; at 6.0 V the factor is 1.30 and fails); E1 measures the hinge and damper torque.

nodes.title: Servo torque factor at 7.2 V, damper at 0 C, real arm ratio
nodes.how: E1 step 6: ring-down at 0 C; confirm the slew + VD hinge-moment bounding case on the bench.
nodes.note: Equal arms (the SERVO.md convention) give 1.47, 2 % short; FIXES2 s2 reports 1.58 with the drawn 12 mm arm and 12.9 mm horn. Bounding case: VD hinge moment, full slew and 0 C together.
